title: Crossing Railroad Tracks in Snow: Check Clear First, Keep Steady Momentum so You Don't Get Stuck on the Rails!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: SUV in foreground faces left across tracks; distant red car in background on curving road does not face it head-on in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Side windows show driver silhouette but no steering wheel is visible to judge left/right position.

single_bulb_signal.note: Right-side crossing signal in mid-right has both red lenses lit simultaneously; left foreground signal has one lit. More than one lit lens on same signal head.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: No left-hand traffic shown; road with yellow centerline at bottom and vehicles not driving on left.

zero_text.note: Crossbucks, plates, and small sign shapes are blank; no letters, numbers, or words visible.

scene_match.note: Shows snowy rural grade crossing with SUV rolling over rails, but crossing displays active stop condition with flashing reds and lowered gate, not the clear tracks described.

result.summary: Active railroad warning violated: right signal shows two lit reds and gate is down while SUV crosses, teaching to proceed against flashing red.

teaching_correct.note: Teaches opposite of safe rule: SUV proceeds across rails under flashing red lights with gate down instead of stopping clear, despite title to check clear first.

result.what_i_see: A dark SUV crosses snow-covered railroad tracks at sunset between two X-crossbuck posts with flashing red lights, with a red car on the snowy road in the background.
